origin.title: Squash everything down to one starting commit (clean history)

bubbles.title: close command
bubbles.hint: close <track>: sets closed {at} on any track, current included (stays current); refuses if already closed; open bubbles keep their state

bubbles.title: Read-only guard
bubbles.hint: every mutating command (add/insert/remove/move/rename/title/hint/fog/type/fill/done/handoff) refuses: track "<name>" is closed (read-only) — fork, diverge or switch to keep working

bubbles.title: Closed rendering
bubbles.hint: show / tracks / status line mark it 🔒 closed (ascii fallback) instead of prev ‹ active › next

bubbles.title: Read-only show
bubbles.hint: closed track: show prints what it does today (track line + numbered bubbles with labels and ↳ hints) — no new history

bubbles.title: Branch off closed
bubbles.hint: fork/diverge from a closed track still work but never write to it (no fork/sides marker); fog gate ignores a closed track

bubbles.title: Always bubble ids
bubbles.hint: every bubble gets its stable id when created (add/insert); older tracks get ids on load, saved on the next write; close ids everything before it freezes

bubbles.title: Closed-parent links
bubbles.hint: child of a closed track runs on: done-pop chain and title sync skip the closed parent

bubbles.title: Close pops parent
bubbles.hint: closing a fork counts as finished: close pops its parent bubble (and on up the chain, like done); done on the parent no longer waits for a closed fork; a closed parent is still skipped

bubbles.title: Cascade-close forks
bubbles.hint: closing a track closes ALL its fork descendants (any state), top down; diverged side tracks stay open; no --force -> refuse and list every track it would close; already closed or missing child -> note, keep cascading; a failing child doesn't stop the rest; re-running close on a closed track cascades to still-open forks; only the top pops its own parent; no --only flag

bubbles.title: Position in link label
bubbles.hint: fork of / diverged from label: show the linked bubble's current position (looked up by id in the other track), not "#id"; fall back to the title when the track or bubble is gone

bubbles.title: Tests, help and docs
bubbles.hint: HELP text (src/lib/cli/args.ts close line: cascades to forks, pops parent), SKILL.md command table + fork section (closed fork = finished, close cascades), README CLI block; rebuild JS; tests for #8-#10 already written
